svg.title: Sluice · code architecture
svg.desc: Open this file in diagrams.net to edit it: the draw.io model is embedded.
svg.text: demo · services · orchestrator · producer · dashboard · smoke · faults
one module per subcommand, imported only when that command runs
app.py: FastAPI over the journals; reads, never drives execution
static/dashboard.html: the page (shipped as package data)
catalog.py: poison · residue · compfail · compretry · zombie · crash · redelivery
failover.py: two orchestrators, one lease, a fenced-off deposed leader
checker.py: EEO clauses graded against the ground-truth ledger
sweep.py: crash at every step boundary x fault mode · bench.py: overhead
core/ · the durable-execution kernel · standard library only
types.py: the frozen Part 4 interfaces · tools.py: the triage workflow + effect types
journal.py: SQLite WAL branch tree, leases, fencing epochs
engine.py: replay, divergence, the barrier, LIFO compensation, bounded escalation
Each layer imports only from the layers below it, lazy imports included. tests/unit/test_architecture.py fails the build if that ever stops being true.
src/sluice, by layer. The kernel needs nothing outside the standard library, so the core demo cannot be taken out by a failed install.
